title: File:Alexandre Ier (NYPL b14504927-1129346).jpg
description:
* Admission is granted through application to the Office of Special Collections.
  • Forms part of Prints by Felix Bracquemond in Samuel Putnam Avery Collection.
  • Holdings checked in departmental copy of Henri Beraldi, Les graveurs du XIXe siecle, v. 3.
  • Portraits, primarily of 19th-century artists and writers, including Alexander I of Russia, Zacharie Astruc, Charles Baudelaire, Pierre Augustin Caron de Beaumarchais, Henri Beraldi, Paul Marc Joseph Chenavard, Leon Cladel, Auguste Comte, Jean-Baptiste-Camille Corot, Alfred de Curzon, Charles Francois Daubigny, Eugene Delacr
